source: Local flying lead to a shaded dash location
front_end: 10 kΩ pull-up to 3V3, RC 10 kΩ / 100 nF at the connector edge
calibration: β from the datasheet; one-point check against a thermometer

source: DP-DCU 2 — L2-S 5, ending in the L2-OAT receptacle at the nose (electrical D-274)
node: 10 kΩ NTC in the airstream ahead of the radiator, grounded at the front star (electrical D-256)
front_end: 10 kΩ pull-up to 3V3 at the DCU, RC 10 kΩ / 100 nF, BAT54S; the front-star-to-dash ground offset is tens of millivolts — negligible for display
note: Display only — there is no automatic climate control

source: On the carrier — 5 mΩ shunt in the common return
calibration: Zero at no load; one known load

source: Local pigtail to the final stage at L3-BLW
node: Logic-level PWM ≥ 20 kHz + ground (+12 V if the module wants it)
front_end: Teensy PWM pin through 100 Ω; 10 kΩ pull-down so the blower is off through a reset
note: D-308: the PMU never PWMs O16 — its ceiling is 400 Hz (electrical D-257)

node: Hobby servos on the door cables (D-073)
front_end: Servo PWM through 330 Ω; own 5 V buck for the servo rail; 470 µF at the header
calibration: Endpoints calibrated at commissioning, stored with the climate memory

node: Seat heat ×2 · seat cool ×2 (low side) · mirror heat (high side, D-369). The nozzles and the de-icer are cancelled (D-329)
front_end: Low-side AOD4184-class FETs ×4 (V-083): seat heat ×2, seat cool ×2 - gate through 100 Ω with a 10 kΩ pull-down, every load off through a reset; SS34 flyback footprints, DNP. Mirror heat: one high-side switch fed from an O15 fuse-block position on the comfort connector (LP46), out on DP-DCU-B 9 (electrical D-369)
calibration: Off-at-reset verified on the bench with a lamp as the load
note: The heat/cool interlock is enforced in firmware as well (D-073). Was x7: the heated nozzle and the park de-icer are cancelled (D-329), freeing two FETs

source: DP-DCU-B 5-8 at the DCU (L3-S3 5-8) → L4-S2 1-5 at the dash post (electrical D-360, D-362)
node: Each mirror is ONE reversible motor plus an electromagnetic clutch coil that selects the axis (Camden, 2026-09-21); both motors share a common
front_end: Three half-bridges - motor common, left motor, right motor - and one low-side driver for both clutch coils together (electrical D-360). Current sizing waits on W-332
note: D-359 supersedes D-326: the DCU drives the mirrors. Input is the panel thumbstick (LP35): two analog axes + press to toggle LEFT/RIGHT. An axis picks the clutch state, its direction picks the motor polarity. The mirrors do not move with the DCU down - accepted in D-359

signal: Mirror thumbstick - X / Y axes + press
source: Panel, on the local ribbon (LP35, D-359)
node: mini 2-axis analog thumbstick with push switch - part not chosen (LP35)
front_end: two ADC inputs and one digital input on the carrier; values drawn with the panel (H-007)
calibration: centre and dead-band set at commissioning
note: confirm - no part chosen. Press toggles LEFT/RIGHT (D-359)

node: key matrix: defog · hatch · fuel door · HVAC mode · recirc · the four window commands (FT14)
front_end: row / column scan on DCU GPIO; sized at H-007
note: a press with the car asleep wakes the DCU, which pulls DP-DCU 6 (SN21)

node: quadrature encoders: fan · temperature · seat heat / cool (count at H-007)
front_end: A / B on DCU GPIO; detents and range in firmware (modules PANEL)
calibration: none - detents and range are firmware
note: encoders, not pots: no calibration on the panel (D-355)

source: DP-DCU 6 → the PMU's wake strip, the seventh diode-OR input (electrical D-350)
front_end: drawn at H-002 - the drive level and sense are confirm against the wake strip's input
note: D-355: pulled when a panel key is pressed with the car asleep

node: The coils of relays K5–K8 at the sill node, 85 to ground (electrical D-363)
front_end: Four high-side switches sourcing 12 V into each coil (a relay coil, well under 1 A); the PMU still gates the motor power on O1 / MOTOR_BUS (electrical D-357)
note: Up and down of one side are never driven together - interlock in firmware (F-017). Which way is up is confirm until the glass moves

node: The coils of relays K3 / K4 at the dash node, whose 86 is fed only during O10's release pulse (electrical D-370)
front_end: Two low-side switches sinking a relay coil (well under 1 A; the relays carry their own coil diode)
note: Ground the chosen coil before asking the PMU for the pulse and hold it through the pulse; never both (F-017)
